column1: # The creatures a mission server spawns, from the bot's packet recordings.
# Written by Tools/Capture/MobExtract - do not edit by hand, re-run it.
# Only creatures inside the generated building: a recording starts at the
# previous zone-in, so the outdoor ones on the way there are in the stream too
# and are cut by the playfield each one says it is in.
# monster is SimpleCharFullUpdate.MonsterData - the body, shared by the rank
# variants of one creature: 17649 is both "34 - Automatic" and "34-V worker".
# Level is given against the mission QL, because that is what it tracks, not the
# player's. Only the pools the bot has run appear.
# healthScale is what this creature's maximum health is a multiple of - see
# MissionCreature.Health, which holds the ramp the scale multiplies.
# A row with pet=1 and pool 0 is not a mission creature at all: it is a name that
# was somebody's pet, kept because that is what lets a world spawn list leave
# them out. PoolExtract only ever asks for the ten real pools, so it never sees
